It is the ideal environment for a great start of your career!

 Role description 
This company has over 450 respectable clients in the entertainment industry. Their clients are manufacturers of games which need to be tested according to international legislation and standards. 
You will either work for the department focusing on iGaming testing or for the department focusing on embedded testing. 
The department Embedded Testing focuses on hardware and software testing. The software is mainly written in C++. The testing process needs to be thoroughly documented. Every week new machines need to be tested so you have a nice variety in your job. You will learn on the job until you have mastered the complete process resulting in all-round testing experience. 
For the department of iGaming you will be responsible for testing online applications, websites and games, mainly written in Java and Python.
